extracted.intended_audience: aspiring memoir writers and readers of literary nonfiction seeking craft guidance
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance on composing literary memoirs: how to shape memory, voice, structure, and emotional truth so a personal life narrative resonates as literature. Emphasizes craft and the therapeutic/identity aspects of memoir writing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Passion about the subject
rubrics_metrics.description: You can count on a memoirist being passionate about the subject.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page emphasizes memoir's 'anybody-who's-lived-can-write-one' democracy but stresses that a strong memoirist is driven by passion for the material; passion fuels engagement and the book's energy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Episodic structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Memoir's structure remains dopily episodic; one event follows another.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlike novels with intricate plots, memoir often proceeds event-to-event (e.g., birth→puberty→sex). Writers should accept and shape an episodic flow rather than force novelistic plotting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Books held together by happenstance and theme
rubrics_metrics.description: The books are held together by happenstance, theme, and other unifying elements.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Since memoirs may lack novel-like plot, authors should use recurring themes and the serendipity of life events to create cohesion across episodes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Convincing, poetic single-person voice
rubrics_metrics.description: The sheer, convincing poetry of a single person trying to make sense of the past.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A powerful, distinctive first-person voice—poetic and convincing—is central; voice can be the primary unifying and compelling quality of a memoir.

rubrics_metrics.name: Making sense of the past / meaning-making
rubrics_metrics.description: The memoirist's project is a single person trying to make sense of the past.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Memoir should do more than list events; it should interpret, order, and illuminate past experiences so they cohere into insight or understanding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exploration of memory and identity
rubrics_metrics.description: The work breaks open concepts of memory and identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Good memoir interrogates how memory shapes identity; writers should examine reliability, perspective, and how recollection constructs the self.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cathartic power of reflection
rubrics_metrics.description: Memoir illuminates the cathartic power of reflecting on the past.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors can use the form's reflective, therapeutic potential; emotional honesty and self-examination can produce catharsis for author and resonance for readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Honest, in-depth probing of dark interior spaces
rubrics_metrics.description: The dark spaces in the author's own skull are probed in depth.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Memoir benefits from thorough, candid exploration of interior life, including flaws, addictions, and painful memories—vulnerability is a strength when rendered artfully.

rubrics_metrics.name: Telling how you dealt with family and friends (inside stories)
rubrics_metrics.description: How she dealt with family and friends get told—and those inside stories are part of the memoir.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Memoir often involves narrating interactions with real people; writers must craft these scenes and reckon with ethical/relational consequences while making those relationships serve the narrative.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of exemplars and writerly anecdotes to illuminate craft
rubrics_metrics.description: The book is anchored by excerpts from favorite memoirs and anecdotes from fellow writers' experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Learning and demonstrating memoir techniques via curated excerpts and peers' anecdotes is recommended: show examples rather than only abstract rules to teach craft effectively.
